output.headline: Provider-focused growth investor with 8 adjacent provider deals, a 93% close rate and a record of paying above the comparable 75th percentile.
output.differentiator: Highest completion rate of any sponsor on the list (13 of 14, 93%), and its 16.5x median multiple paid is second only to Blackstone among the peers. [K:closed_share, V:comps]

acquirer_overview.title: Growth equity firm with a provider-heavy, high-completion record
points: Growth equity investor across Technology, Consumer, Financial Services, Healthcare and Life Sciences; AUM US$125.3 billion per its infobox citing SEC Form ADV. [P:1, P:2]
Closed 13 of 14 deals (93%), all control deals, across 6 active years from 2019 to 2024. [K:closed_share, K:control_share, K:years_active, T:record]
Provider deals make up 9 of 14, and 4 deals were signed since 2022, so the provider focus is current. [A:angles, K:recent]

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A provider specialist whose deal history spans the target's neighbourhood
points: Deals in this or neighbouring sub-sectors and its share of deals that closed are modest factors in its likelihood. [S:sector_rel, S:close_rate_s]
Physician Groups is its largest sub-sector with 4 deals; it has 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors. [K:by_sub_sector, T:record]
The deal is not smaller than its usual range, a slight factor for; its share of deals in the target's sub-sector is a slight factor against. [S:not_smaller, S:sector_share]

precedent_activity.title: Physician group and home health deals, one in the target's own sub-sector
points: Oak Health: $1,708M Merger of Equals in 2021, same sub-sector as the target, at 18.8x EBITDA. [D:MA-2021-0066]
Crest Medical Practice: $121M Leveraged Buyout in 2023, Physician Groups, at 11.5x EBITDA. [D:MA-2023-0499]
Harbor Home Health Partners: $15M Strategic Acquisition in the Midwest in 2022 at 16.9x. Only 3 of 14 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band. [D:MA-2022-0273, K:size_band]

valuation_context.title: 75th percentile is defensible, and its own multiples sit above it
points: 70 comparable deals: 25th percentile 10.7x, median 12.8x, 75th percentile 15.3x EBITDA. [V:comps]
Target margin of 16.8% against a comparable median of 12.9% supports upper-quartile pricing; it sits above 87% of comparables. [V:comps]
Median paid is 16.5x, above the 75th percentile. At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M, with an IRR at the ask of 18.7% against a 20% target. [V:comps, V:lbo]

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M. [V:lbo]
risk_flags.reality: Same-exit maximum is $193M, and it has no open platform in the sub-sector. [V:lbo, A:angles]

risk_flags.title: Thin record in the target's own sub-sector
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector; the share of deals there counts slightly against it. [T:record, S:sector_share]
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 deals in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and Physician Groups is its largest with 4. [T:record, K:by_sub_sector]
risk_flags.reality: The one same-sub-sector deal was Oak Health at $1,708M in 2021, far larger than this target. [D:MA-2021-0066]

risk_flags.title: Limited Midwest depth
risk_flags.concern: Only 2 deals in the target's region. [T:record]
risk_flags.mitigant: Harbor Home Health Partners was a closed Midwest deal in 2022. [D:MA-2022-0273]
risk_flags.reality: Welsh Carson and GTCR each have 6 Midwest deals, so they may out-credential it regionally. [T:record]

conviction.rationale: Medium: 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector and 8 in adjacent provider sub-sectors support the case, but no open platform in the sub-sector is neutral and caps conviction. [C:conviction]
